```{r}


library(exscidata)
library(tidyverse)


p1 <- millward |> 
  ggplot(aes(RNA, protein_synthesis)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
              se = FALSE) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0.004952, 
              slope = 0.010498, 
              color = "darkorange", 
              lty = 2)
  

# Lage en statistisk modell 

m <- lm(protein_synthesis ~ RNA, 
        data = millward)
 

# Beregne en korrelasjon
mc <- cor(millward$protein_synthesis, 
          millward$RNA)


# Residualer

# Lagre modellens koeffisienter
int <- coef(m)[1]
slope <- coef(m)[2]

p2 <- millward |> 
  # Beregne prediksjoner
  mutate(pred = int + slope * RNA, 
         resid = protein_synthesis - pred) |> 
  ggplot(aes(RNA, resid)) + geom_point() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)



cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, 
                   ncol = 1)



```


$$y_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \times \text{RNA}_i$$
